# Config: WindowLook

> **Reader:** `Appearance` (`config/Appearance.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.WindowLook` · category Compositor · scope look

Window look: Settings that make windows match axiom. While on, they win over your compositor's own config, and they come along when you share or import a config.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.

- [`WindowLook.opacity`](WindowLook.opacity.md)
